opis: The cosy kitchen from the reference picture (the same wallpaper, window, wall clock, mint fridge, mint cupboard and big wooden table), warm afternoon light. At the left wall the two little wooden wall SHELVES: on the LOWER shelf a small brown paper bag of POTATOES and a small glass jar of golden HONEY, on the UPPER shelf a big puffy yellow bag of CRISPS and a tall jar of white POPCORN. In front of the cupboard stands a small white kitchen STOVE; the big BEAR lifts a big heavy silver soup POT with both paws onto the stove, puffing his cheeks with the effort, steam rising from the orange pumpkin SOUP in it. The BEAVER claps, the BUNNY sits at the table with a spoon and a bowl, laughing. Warm, homely and happy.
